InstructionStatus.name: Instruction Status
InstructionStatus.definition: Status of each individual meeting instruction(s) included in the instruction message identified in InstructionType/InstructionIdentification.

CancellationStatus.name: Cancellation Status
CancellationStatus.definition: Status of the meeting instruction cancellation request message or of the individual meeting instruction cancellation request(s). The message is identified in InstructionType/InstructionCancellationIdentification.
